podcast.title: Definitive Version
podcast.body: The Righteous Brothers issued what is considered the definitive version of "Unchained Melody" in 1965. This recording, primarily featuring Bobby Hatfield, reached number four on the Hot 100 and was a very big hit. "In the summer of 1965, the righteous brothers Unchained Melody single reached number four on the Hot 100, a very big hit."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Competing Reissues
podcast.body: Due to the song's prominent feature in the 1990 film "Ghost," "Unchained Melody" surged back onto the charts, but with a catch. The Verve label reissued the original 1965 version on vinyl 45 (reaching number 13, fueled by radio), while Bobby Hatfield re-recorded a new version for Curb Records (reaching number 19, selling a million copies on cassette and CD) due to royalty issues. This resulted in The Righteous Brothers competing against themselves with two versions in the Top 20 simultaneously. "By the fall of 1990, the righteous brothers were competing against themselves on the charts."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
